verdict.rationale: Agora is a SaaS real-time voice, video and AI-agent platform, so a training-data opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack has no policy, setting or contractual statement about excluding customer data from AI model training. Self-hosted recording for compliance and certificate rotation are related controls, not a training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
